objective: Evaluate the frozen ABCB1 v0.4-dev selective risk screener on the largest accessible structure-linked external evidence while preserving endpoint and source distinctions.

new_external_sources.endpoint: log10 MDR1-MDCK efflux ratio, B-to-A divided by A-to-B
new_external_sources.claim_limit: continuous MDR1-MDCK efflux-risk validation only; not matched-parental or inhibitor-rescue substrate truth

new_external_sources.endpoint: author-curated P-gp substrate or nonsubstrate class
new_external_sources.claim_limit: retrospective heterogeneous-source corroboration; exact/source overlap and majority-vote labels prevent pristine external-validation claims

identity_policy.primary_analysis: exclude exact connectivity overlap with either frozen reference panel
identity_policy.model_reference_identity_outputs: retain as abstentions in full-set operational coverage but exclude from external accepted-performance denominators
identity_policy.duplicate_policy: collapse repeated standardized connectivity within each source before performance analysis

predeclared_endpoint_rules.biogen_binary_sensitivity_cut: high efflux if log10(ER) >= log10(2); low efflux otherwise
predeclared_endpoint_rules.biogen_primary_continuous_test: Spearman correlation between frozen primary calibrated probability and log10(ER)
predeclared_endpoint_rules.biogen_selective_test: compare log10(ER) distributions for accepted high-risk versus accepted low-risk calls
predeclared_endpoint_rules.daood_binary_rule: use only author final binary P-gp substrate classes; exclude inconclusive, inhibitor-only, and missing-structure rows

metrics: Spearman rho with scaffold-cluster bootstrap confidence interval
accepted balanced accuracy, MCC, high-risk precision, and low-risk negative predictive value
accepted high-versus-low endpoint median difference and Cliff's delta
per-source metrics without naive pooling of source-dependent rows
prohibitions: do not modify the frozen v0.4 model, thresholds, rejector, or applicability rules after seeing these outcomes
do not pool assay endpoints as if they were one biological truth label
do not describe retrospective heterogeneous data as prospective validation
do not infer intact-ADC transport, intracellular unbound exposure, resistance, efficacy, or clinical DDI
do not hide coverage, class-specific accepted counts, or source overlap

decision_rule.quantity_support: may support an external ABCB1 efflux-risk ranking/screening claim if the primary Biogen continuous direction is positive with a scaffold-bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval excluding zero and accepted high-risk rows show higher ER than accepted low-risk rows
decision_rule.strict_predictor_upgrade: not permitted without a new outcome-unseen matched-parental or inhibitor-rescue source containing both positive and negative calls
